dedupe_keys.name: eries the aerodynamics of platooning and overtaking vehicles

description: ERIES publishes wind-tunnel pressures, loads and wake measurements from up to three heavy ground-vehicle models. Tests use a 1:20 geometric scale and compare isolated vehicles, platoons and staged overtaking manoeuvres. The source reports forty-four overtaking configurations and several crosswind angles. The measurements support aerodynamic comparisons of road-vehicle arrangements. Coverage: Temporal coverage is not stated in the reviewed source. Geographic extent follows the named site or scope; unstated extents and sampling intervals remain unknown. Access: public 4TU.ResearchData metadata links describe the release. Formats: CSV, XLSX, DOCX, PDF, STL, JPEG and PNG images and Matlab scripts. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Cost and present file access are unverified. Caveats: Model-scale configurations do not establish behaviour for all vehicles or real traffic conditions. Simulation uses follow the source-defined purpose above. Related resources are retained in the same native collection with their distinct identities.
